INSTRUMENT_FAMILIES.doc: The instrument families a channel may be assigned, a broad prior and never an identification: HRP narrows where its detector looks for a fundamental and how many voices it looks for by the family (HRP_FAMILY_SEARCH), and nothing else. The order is the integer that crosses a port or a process boundary (omx-dsp's OmxHrpFamily, the HRP live face's family port). A channel with no family carries -1, which no id names, and the detector then runs its own wide defaults; so the set has no come-up id.
